cards.title: Six triggers, all planned before cutover
items: Unexplained reconciliation variance is 0% tolerance, not a negotiated threshold
Critical jobs failing, identity outage, unenforced security controls, SLA violations, or revoked sign-off all trigger it

cards.title: Split-brain is the failure mode to design around
items: Source and target both accepting writes is the most dangerous rollback outcome
Always make one environment read-only before re-enabling the other -- never both live at once

cards.title: If rollback is not viable, roll forward instead
items: Fix the blocking issue in target, replay missing data from source backups, extend hypercare
Test the rollback procedure itself in a pilot wave, before it is ever needed for real
